name: Dancing Needle
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
These dainty silver needles are considered a great boon to adventurers and tailors alike. One needs only start the first stitch in a damaged garment or other piece of cloth, and the needle begins to sew, patching any rips or tears along the way. Thread, appropriately colored for whatever garment is being repaired, forms even as it's expended, changing hue as necessary to perfectly match the item.
